Method of Attack: Phishing emails impersonating Ukrainian government agencies to distribute fake Windows antivirus updates
Fake AV update executable downloads and installs Cobalt Strike beacon and additional malware payloads
Use of Themida packer to protect executables from reverse engineering and detection
Downloader fetches and executes base64-encoded payloads
Persistence via Windows registry key modifications
Deployment of GraphSteel and GrimPlant backdoors written in Go for network reconnaissance, command execution, and file operations
Attack Vector: Phishing emails with links to fake AV update download sites
Download and execution of malicious executables masquerading as Windows updates
Indicators of Compromise: Phishing emails impersonating Ukrainian government agencies
French website (now offline) hosting fake AV update downloads
Discord CDN hosting 'one.exe' Cobalt Strike beacon
Files: one.exe, dropper.exe, java-sdk.exe, microsoft-cortana.exe, oracle-java.exe
